guardrails: Preserve the current dirty worktree and user changes.
Create an explicit keep-list before any delete or move.
Never delete .env, the current databases, .venv-cuda, node_modules or D:/AIModels during repository cleanup without separate authority.
Retain machine-readable summaries/hashes before removing large binary evaluation payloads.
Use exact resolved paths and a dry-run inventory before every recursive operation.

steps.action: Remove disposable .tmp content after exact path review
Separate canonical JSON/MD evidence from large historical model/runtime payloads

steps.destination_policy: one dated docs/history or release-archive location chosen during cleanup

steps.action: Remove caches and generated browser state
